title: Weak solvability of a nonlinear Boussinesq groundwater flow model with mixed boundary conditions: the Moche CHAVIMOCHIC aquifer
summary: We prove weak solvability for a two dimensional nonlinear Boussinesq type groundwaterflow problem motivated by the Moche CHAVIMOCHIC aquifer in northern Peru. The model couples state dependent storage and transmissivity with a boundary decomposition into Dirichlet, Neumann, and nonlinear Robin parts dictated by the hydrogeological geometry.
